## Source map — LAW-005

**Document:** “Acuerdo 173/2022”  
**Title:** December 2022 fuel-stimulus agreement  
**Source role:** Executive/legislative record  
**Document type/status:** Federal Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (SHCP) administrative agreement announcing fuel-tax stimulus percentages, amounts, reduced excise-tax quotas, and per-liter amounts. The extract does not establish that this was a statute, budget amendment, political pact, or comprehensive “stimulus agreement.”

### Atomic claims

| ID | Claim | Classification | Locator |
|---|---|---|---|
| LAW-005-01 | The issuing institution is the SHCP; the document bears the national seal and identifies Karina Ramírez Arras as Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos no Tributarios. | Observed official record | Block 1, heading and opening paragraph |
| LAW-005-02 | The agreement relies on Article Primero of the 27 December 2016 decree establishing IEPS fuel stimuli and its subsequent modifications, and Article Primero of the 4 March 2022 decree establishing complementary stimuli for automotive fuels. | Observed legal authority | Block 1, opening paragraph |
| LAW-005-03 | The operative period is 10–16 December 2022. | Observed operative provision | Block 1, opening paragraph; Articles Primero–Cuarto, Block 2 |
| LAW-005-04 | For gasoline below 91 octane, the fiscal stimulus percentage is 26.96%; for diesel, 59.77%; for gasoline at or above 91 octane and non-fossil fuels, 0.00%. | Observed official provision | Block 2, Article Primero |
| LAW-005-05 | The stated stimulus amounts are MXN 1.4803/liter for gasoline below 91 octane, MXN 3.6071/liter for diesel, and MXN 0.0000/liter for gasoline at or above 91 octane and non-fossil fuels. | Observed official provision | Block 2, Article Segundo |
| LAW-005-06 | The stated reduced IEPS quotas are MXN 4.0114/liter, MXN 4.6375/liter, and MXN 2.4283/liter respectively for the three fuel categories. | Observed official provision | Block 2, Article Tercero |
| LAW-005-07 | Complementary stimulus amounts are MXN 0.0000/liter for all listed fuel categories during the period. | Observed official provision | Block 2, Article Cuarto |
| LAW-005-08 | The agreement was signed in Mexico City on 8 December 2022 by Karina Ramírez Arras, acting in substitution for the Undersecretary of Finance and Public Credit, and includes a signature rubric. | Observed official record | Block 2, Transitorio Único and signature block |
| LAW-005-09 | The agreement enters into force the day after its publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación. | Observed legal provision | Block 2, Transitorio Único |

### Interpretation and limits

The text indicates a time-limited fuel-tax mechanism, potentially relevant to shock-response policy and fiscal policy. It does not state the fiscal cost, foregone revenue, borrowing effect, offsetting measures, beneficiaries by income or region, agency implementation procedures, monitoring, audit, performance triggers, or sunset arrangements beyond the specified 10–16 December application period.

The extract does not establish actual pump-price effects, inflation relief, fuel availability, distributional incidence, implementation outcomes, universality, fairness, causal impact, or attribution of results to AMLO. It also does not provide a publication date, so the exact effective date cannot be calculated from the extract alone.

### Source role and contrary material

This is an official SHCP operative record for specified tax treatment. It records legal authority and announced amounts, not observed outcomes. No contrary material appears within the supplied extract.

### Reopen points for a stronger model

Reopen the full publication to verify the publication date and complete legal text; inspect the cited 2016 and 2022 decrees and later modifications; determine whether funding was appropriated or represented foregone tax revenue; and seek separate evidence on price transmission, fiscal effects, beneficiaries, implementation, and outcomes.
